question: Ambubachi fair is celebrated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Ambubachi Mela** is an annual Hindu fair held at the Kamakhya Temple in **Assam**.
 
• It is celebrated during the monsoon season, typically in the month of June.
 
• The festival marks the yearly menstruation course of goddess Kamakhya.
